prompt:
Photographic texture source for a photorealistic racing game set in Salwa, Kuwait, in 1985. Real photograph, not a render, not an illustration. Shot perfectly straight-on with a long lens so it reads as an orthographic elevation: no perspective, no vanishing lines, verticals perfectly vertical. Soft, even, shadowless daylight (bright overcast) so the game engine can add its own sun and shadows. True-to-life colours, fine surface detail: hairline cracks, dust, water stains, sun bleaching.

Wide photograph of the sky over Kuwait at golden hour in summer, taken from a rooftop looking at the horizon, the horizon line exactly at the bottom edge of the frame with nothing but sky above: pale dusty blue at the top fading to warm peach and soft gold near the horizon, a few thin high streaks of cirrus, the haze of fine desert dust. No sun disc, no buildings, no birds.

Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermarks; people; cars; satellite dishes; modern LED lights or modern glass curtain walls; mosques, minarets, domes; flags; strong cast shadows; perspective distortion; buildings; ground.
